subject: Superintendent Entry Plan Report
overview: The Medford School Committee approved renaming the Foreign Language Department to the World Language Department and voted to add $20,000 to the athletic budget for gymnastics floor repairs. Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent also delivered the findings from her entry plan report outlining district strengths, challenges, and strategic priorities.

items.title: Minutes and Financial Approvals
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes from April 1, 2019, as well as bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Capital Projects Report and High School Beautification
items.summary: The committee accepted capital project reports and voted to refer Medford High School campus beautification and facility improvements to the Buildings and Grounds Subcommittee.

items.title: Recognitions, Donations, and Grants
items.summary: The committee recognized coach John Skerry for receiving a sportsmanship award, accepted donations for McGlynn Middle School and Columbus Elementary School, and approved a $2,500 Captain Planet Foundation grant for a high school student composting project.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent shared updates on community events, student achievements, upcoming kindergarten registration, and district programs.

items.title: Credit for Life Fair Report
items.summary: Dr. Bernadette Ricciardelli presented a report on the financial literacy Credit for Life Fair conducted for over 300 high school students.

items.title: World Language Department Name Change
items.summary: The committee voted to formally rename the Foreign Language Department to the World Language Department.

items.title: Gymnastics Facility Upgrades
items.summary: Following a facility inspection report by Athletic Director Bob Maloney, the committee voted to allocate $20,000 in the athletic budget to replace the high school gymnastics spring floor.

items.title: Superintendent's Entry Plan Findings Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent outlined findings from her first-year entry plan, detailing district accomplishments, key themes from staff and community listening sessions, and areas for strategic focus.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of several community members and district staff family members.
